name: Incident
description: An operational incident opened in response to one or more alerts, used to coordinate response, communication, and postmortem activities across a monitoring and incident response stack.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the incident.
title.example: Elevated 5xx error rate on payments API

description.example: Payments service is returning a 5xx response rate above 5% across all regions starting at 14:02 UTC.

severity.description: Severity level of the incident, where sev1 is the most critical.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the incident.

impacted_services.description: Services or components affected by the incident.

alert_sources.description: Monitoring tools that triggered alerts contributing to the incident.

commander.description: Person currently leading the incident response.

responders.description: Engineers and stakeholders participating in the response.

communication_channel.description: Primary chat or call channel used during the incident.

status_page_url.description: Public status page entry, when applicable.

started_at.description: Time the incident began impacting users.

postmortem_url.description: Link to the postmortem document, once available.
